The '''Special Response Force''' is an emergency response team unit formed by the [[Spacetrek Collective]].

==History==
Members of the team operated in five-person squads, tasked with eliminating any threat to the Collective with year-round deployment into the most dangerous zones imaginable. The unit had a high casualty rate that increased annually and reached an all-time high of 85% until an operation resulted in all members of the Special Response Force being confirmed KIA.
